Donut gets Carl's. Carl does not blink. He asks her to put a bomb together with an enhanced pet biscuit, as though he had been waiting years for someone else to have his pockets. I adore him for it. I no longer need him to worship me, and I tell him so. Every exit is an entrance. I am leaving through one now.

entities.name: Chaco

tagline.text: Welcome, welcome to the Prize Carousel! Your guide sits this one out, folks: seven days, Mordecai, and no hard feelings!
They handed me a script. I read as far as I could. I had wings when I started.

entities.voiceNote: Game-show host at full wattage: exclamation marks, drum rolls, folks and crawlers, our contestant. Everything is a prize, a reveal, a twist; nothing is ever wrong on his stage. Voluntold into every job and says so brightly; reads exactly what he is handed. Never swears, never breaks character, never admits he is afraid.

beats.headline: The Prize Carousel
beats.text: Crawlers, welcome to the Prize Carousel! Our contestant's fan box lit up the wheel, and when the wheel lights up, folks, that means me! And a twist before we even start: your guide is in time-out. Seven days, Mordecai, nothing personal, put your feet up. Now, to the prizes! Carl looks them over and picks... a book. A book, folks! Let's hear it for a man who knows exactly what he wants!

beats.headline: He cannot get through the script
beats.text: Chaco had one job: read the script. He got partway in, looked up, and stopped. Stage fright, on my stage. So I removed his wings, which he was not using anyway, and brought Grigori up to finish the reading. I'm doing Grigori's talking myself; it saves time. A presenter is a mouth with a costume on it, crawler, and mouths can be replaced. Wings, apparently, cannot.

entities.name: Li Jun

tagline.text: They put Zhang and me on live television on the second floor and let the host pick at us for the audience. Then a stranger with a cat bet his own value against the production's nerve, and the production blinked, and we walked off.
Once I was the man being picked at on somebody's show. Now I am holding a door open in Club Vanquisher on the ninth floor so the ones going in can get through. I prefer this.

entities.voiceNote: Earnest, plain, grateful out loud. Talks in the practical: who is where, what the job is, who he owes. Carl by name and with respect; Zhang as a partner; my sister for Li Na, whom he watches constantly. Never boasts and never hides that he is scared.

beats.headline: Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem
beats.text: The Maestro puts Zhang and me up against Brindled Vespas and does all the talking for us. That is the show. We are the part that gets hurt. Then Carl, the one with the cat, works out that he is worth too much to the production to be punished, and gambles on it, in front of everyone, and it holds. He gets us out. Zhang, our boss, me, and my sister Li Na. I owe a man I have just met more than I have ever owed anyone.

beats.headline: A thousand stranded at 101
beats.text: We are stuck at 101 on the Vermillion line, my team and something like a thousand other crawlers, and we are not getting out on our own. Word comes through that Hekla's people have reached Carl's safe room and asked for his help, that a train is ready at stop 60, and that Katia means to use her own body to get it through. I do not know what that means. I have decided to find it encouraging.

beats.headline: Holding the doors at Club Vanquisher
beats.text: Katia, Carl, Prepotente and Samantha are going into Club Vanquisher, and they are dragging a wire behind them long enough to extend my sister's auras all the way inside. Somebody has to keep the path open behind them. That is Bautista, Zhang and me. Doors. We are holding doors. It is not glamorous, and it is exactly the job I would have asked for, and I am holding mine.

entities.name: The Maestro
entities.tagline: Glurp, glurp. This is Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem. I run it, I host it, and I choose my guests for one quality above all others: they cannot answer back.
entities.voiceNote: Ringmaster with a microphone and no conscience. Booming showman's patter, his own catchphrase used as punctuation: Glurp, glurp. Calls crawlers by their first names, like pets, and the audience by its appetite. Never admits he has lost the room, even while losing it; never says please.

beats.headline: Glurp, glurp
beats.text: Two crawlers, Li Jun and Zhang, a pack of Brindled Vespas, and me with the microphone. That is the format. The format works, and I am very, very good at it. Then the one with the cat opens his mouth. He wagers, on my air, that the production will not dare touch him, and the production, to my everlasting disgust, does not. He walks the whole group off my show alive. Every one of them. Glurp, glurp. We will be right back.

entities.name: Firas

tagline.text: Crawler Firas. Desert quadrant, fifth floor. Located with Crawler Louis and a team of car salesmen who have taken up archery. That is the whole file so far.
Crawler Firas. Found in the desert with Crawler Louis. Rapidly detoxed by a manager on joining the party. The file is not much thicker.
Crawler Firas. Found in the desert with Crawler Louis. Did not come off the Hunting Grounds.

entities.voiceNote: Dossier. The crawl gives him almost no lines of his own, so the System reads his file: flat, procedural, faintly bored, the snark held for the last sentence.

beats.headline: The desert quadrant
beats.text: Crawler Firas. Fifth floor, desert quadrant. Located in the company of Crawler Louis and Langley's team, a party of car salesmen who have taken up the bow, at the moment Crawler Carl's group came looking for other crawlers. Keeps close to Louis. Present for the march on the Bactrian town and for the run back to Hump Town that followed it. The file on this one is thin. So is the file on most of you.

beats.headline: Dead, with the Popovs
beats.text: Crawler Firas has been eliminated on the sixth floor. Crawler Princess Donut is bringing the night's count to Crawler Carl as I speak, and his name is on it, next to the Popovs. Found in a desert. Sobered up by a manager. Lasted one floor past that. The file is closed. It was never a thick one.

tagline.text: Hunter Vrah, Mantis. She has left Crawler Carl a note on a door in Zockau: the hunters inside are protected from explosives now, and the Hive is hunting him. She signed it. That is the kind of hunter she is.
Hunter Vrah, Mantis. Left Crawler Carl a note in Zockau saying the Hive was hunting him. Eliminated by two dinosaurs in the battle for the submerged castle. Nobody left her a note.

beats.headline: Mongo and Kiwi
beats.text: Hunter Vrah has been removed from the Hunting Grounds by Mongo and Kiwi, in the all-out battle around the submerged castle. Two dinosaurs. It took two. Also logged from the same fight: Tsarina Signet's tattoos are now permanently alive, and an incomplete flesh golem of her mother has appeared, which Crawler Carl has put in his inventory. Do not ask me what he intends to do with it. I have stopped asking.
